findings.test: REQ-006 AC1: After deleting, the task no longer appears in the list
findings.explanation: DELETE /api/tasks/:id answers 204. The wiring contract says a handler answers 200 for everything except a create (201). The test is right to expect 200.
findings.proposedFix: Make DELETE /api/tasks/:id answer 200 and send the controller result as JSON, as the generated wiring does for other routes, instead of 204.
